easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
